title: Pause Polling in Background Tabs in Inertia.js v3.9
content:
Inertia.js v3.9 adds a background option to pause polling in hidden tabs, a navigate event type for history restores, and fixes for back navigation.

The post Pause Polling in Background Tabs in Inertia.js v3.9 appeared first on Laravel News.
